Aisha C.: Kicking off Seaborn pilot onboarding. Objective: 6-week POC for in-store assistant + receipt parsing. Need to confirm owners, success signals, timeline, and any renewal risk triggers.

Marcus R.: I'll own infra + staging endpoint. Need either cross-account read or a sanitized export. ETA endpoint Fri.

Devon L.: I'll lead ML tuning and evals. If PCI blocks raw exports, I can generate labeled synthetic receipts. Need 20 sample queries to start.

Priyanka (Seaborn): Hi! We can share masked receipts. Marco (our security) wants a short data-handling note before upload. We care about speed to value 1 - renewal depends on pilot showing quick wins.

Aisha C.: Proposed success criteria draft:
- Intent accuracy (top-1) >= 88% on labeled set
- Extraction accuracy (totals/dates) >= 92%
- p95 latency < 800ms under expected load
- Enablement: 2 sessions completed + runbook sign-off

OnboardBot: Reminder: "Seaborn security review" scheduled 2024-04-09 17:00 UTC.

Marcus R.: Immediate owners & next steps: Marcus 1 provisioning + endpoint by Fri; Devon 1 baseline eval set + synthetic fallback by Tue; Aisha 1 schedule weekly check-ins and security call.

Priyanka (Seaborn): I'll confirm redaction approach by EOD and upload 10 example queries.

Aisha C.: Great. Reconvene Fri 10am PT to validate endpoint + data. If security delays exports we'll go synthetic and push enablement as planned. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

OnboardBot: Thread saved to #cs-playbooks (Seaborn pilot).
